_comment_max_age: Suppress notifications for listings whose Craigslist posting date is older than this many days ('blatantly stale'). Only fires when the date is known; unknown-age listings still notify. Set null/0 to disable.

filters._comment_exclude_locations: Backstop for circle bleed. Studios/1BR only, Brooklyn-scoped. Clinton Hill/Downtown/DUMBO/Gowanus added since they're NOT on Cole's list. Border listings tagged with a wanted+unwanted hood get dropped.
filters._comment_bedrooms: Bedroom counts are enforced per-source via Craigslist min_bedrooms/max_bedrooms URL params (reliable structured field), NOT keyword excludes, so we can mix 3BR/2BR/studio scenarios.

_comment_sources: Craigslist works reliably. Sources marked enabled:false actively block bots (403) - use their native saved-search alerts instead. See README.

sources._scenario: SOLO — studio/1BR under $3k for Cole. Brooklyn via Craigslist. West Village + SoHo (Manhattan) are NOT here: Craigslist's Manhattan geo-search is broken, so those go through StreetEasy/Zillow email alerts -> Gmail forward -> this ntfy topic. See README.

sources.name: Studio/1BR ≤$3k · Brownstone Bklyn (Ft Greene/Bklyn Hts/Cobble/Boerum/Prospect Hts/Park Slope)

sources._scenario: Non-Craigslist sources. Listings Project is the ONLY working source that reaches Manhattan (West Village/SoHo) — Craigslist's Manhattan geo-search is broken. Reddit is high-noise so it requires an explicit neighborhood + studio/1BR keyword match.

sources.name: Listings Project · NYC (incl. West Village / SoHo)

filters._comment: Excludes short-stay/furnished rentals (nightly & weekly rates), ISO/seeking posts, and 2BR+. Price is the MONTHLY figure parsed from the detail page.

_comment_topic: Topic blank here; set via NTFY_TOPIC repo secret.
